title: Scalar extension respects the geometric pullback compositor
statement: For coefficient systems R and S and a compatible change a as in [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], let h:X→Z and k:Z→Y be morphisms. Suppose the coefficient identifications for h followed by k are the canonical composite identifications for both R and S. On any derived R_Y-module L, scalar extension of the inverse R-pullback compositor followed by scalarPull along h≫k equals scalarPull along h, followed by S-pullback of scalarPull along k, followed by the inverse S-pullback compositor. The equality concerns only scalar extension and geometric pullback, without tensors or compact supports.

source.place: Tags 0D6D and 07A6: composition of inverse image and the mates correspondence

proof.text: Take the ordinary inverse-image/restriction squares to their geometric mates. The normalized restriction/direct-image comparisons are identity on sections, while the normalized direct-image compositors pull sections along the same fibre-product pasting isomorphism. Thus the direct-image square commutes, and injectivity of the mate equivalence gives the ordinary inverse-image square. Exact localization preserves that square. Identify scalarPull with its scalar-adjunction mate using proEtaleRingSheafChangeAdjunction and the iterated-mate identity. Taking scalar mates of the localized square gives the desired equation, after cancelling the invertible S-compositor.

proof_origin.note: The scalar-only step underlying the tensor/open transport; the canonical right-adjoint maps are normalized on sections.

from.place: Scalar/pullback compositor compatibility in its proof

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPull_geometric_composition
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : X ⟶ Z) (k : Z ⟶ Y)
    (hR : R.pull (h ≫ k) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k
      (R.ring Y) (R.ring Z) (R.ring X) (R.pull k) (R.pull h))
    (hS : S.pull (h ≫ k) = proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients h k
      (S.ring Y) (S.ring Z) (S.ring X) (S.pull k) (S.pull h))
    (L : DerivedCategory (pbcModules Y (R.ring Y))) :
    (pbcDerivedExtend (a.map X)).map
        ((geometricPullComposition R h k hR).inv.app L) ≫
      (scalarPull a (h ≫ k)).hom.app L =
    (scalarPull a h).hom.app ((pull R k).obj L) ≫
      (pull S h).map ((scalarPull a k).hom.app L) ≫
      (geometricPullComposition S h k hS).inv.app
        ((pbcDerivedExtend (a.map Y)).obj L)
